evidence.snippet: We introduce DriveSpatial, a benchmark of 15.6K human-verified QA pairs across 20 tasks from five large-scale AD datasets.

claire_radar.motivation: Spatiotemporal intelligence in autonomous driving (AD) requires an agent to integrate multi-view observations into a coherent scene representation, maintain object continuity across viewpoints and time, and reason about spatial relations, interactions, and future dynamics.

source.title: DRIVESPATIAL: A Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Intelligence in VLMs for Autonomous Driving

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing AD vision-language benchmarks focus on static, single-view QA, leaving unclear whether VLMs can reason over dynamic driving scenes. DriveSpatial provides a multi-sourced, human-verified protocol to measure spatiotemporal reasoning and reveals a substantial human-model gap.
